name: q-in-connect-passthrough
description: Lex V2 bot that delegates every utterance to an Amazon Q in Connect assistant. Three locales (en_US, es_US, pt_BR) using Nova Sonic v2 unified speech.

botName.description: Per-tenant Lex V2 bot name. Must be unique in the AWS account.

qAssistantArn.description: ARN of the Amazon Q in Connect (Wisdom) assistant the bot will delegate to.

alias.name: prod
alias.description: Stable alias used by Connect to invoke the bot.
